name: Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur
positioning: City-centre Grand Hyatt overlooking the Petronas Twin Towers, next to the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre
best_for: Travelers who want Petronas Twin Towers views from a central base
Guests who value club lounge access and a spa with Malay herbal traditions

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Petronas Twin Towers and is adjacent to the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Golden Triangle shopping, dining and entertainment district.
The Grand Suite has a living room and a round marble bathtub.
The Grand Club Lounge offers personalized check-in and check-out, complimentary breakfast, all-day refreshments and evening cocktails with canapes.
There is a wading pool for children, with complimentary kids' amenities.
The fitness centre has Technogym cardiovascular and strength-training machines.
The business centre is on the hotel's highest floor, in the Sky Lobby.
The hotel bottles its own water in-house, in reusable glass bottles.
Le Petit Chef is a theatrical dinner that pairs a 3D mapping performance with cuisines from across Asia.
JPteres serves authentic Malaysian flavours, set against greenery at the Ground Lobby.

highlights.text: The outdoor swimming pool has a view of the Petronas Twin Towers.
ESSA Spa uses ramuan, the traditional Malay preparation of herbal healing ingredients.
Deluxe corner rooms offer a 180-degree panoramic view of the Kuala Lumpur city skyline.
Guest room bathrooms have a liquid crystal glass cube that can be adjusted for privacy.
THIRTY8 sits on the 38th floor with a 360-degree view of the city and show kitchens.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends booking restaurants in advance, as its dining outlets can be full for walk-ins.
There are no lifeguards on duty at the pool, and children must be accompanied by an adult.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with city traffic to consider.
